Char1 "Prince Lucien Ultrius and Dawnpiercer":

Enhancement: Bringer of Justice (+30 pts)

Enhancement: Mysterious Guardian (+35 pts)

Char3 "Lord Vaelor Ultrius and Soverign Eclipse": 
1x Knight Crusader (435 pts): Avenger gatling cannon, Heavy flamer, Titanic feet, Ironstorm missile pod, Questoris heavy stubber, Questoris heavy stubber, Rapid-fire battle cannon
Enhancement: Hunter's Eye (+25 pts)

Char4 "Princess Isolde Ultrius and Corona's Edge" : 
1x Knight Destrier (265 pts): Questoris heavy stubber, Titanic feet, Chastiser gatling cannon, Frag bombard

"Lady Caelia Ultrius and The Long Vigil"
1x Armiger Helverin (140 pts): 2x Armiger autocannon, Armoured feet, Questoris heavy stubber

"Lord Abner Ultrius and The Hidden Flame"
1x Armiger Warglaive (140 pts): Reaper chain-cleaver, Thermal spear, Questoris heavy stubber

10x Sisters of Battle Squad (110 pts)
